richiami.difetto: For affected machines when the front brake is applied whilst riding it is catching the brake pad securing pin. Examination has shown that an incorrect wheel spacer and incorrectly sized caliper holding bracket may have been fitted during manufacture.
richiami.modello: TR125-GP2-E55 Brake disc & caliper , TR125-GP2-E55 Brake disc & caliper
richiami.rimedio: Replacement of the front wheel spacer caliper bracket and brake pads.

richiami.difetto: Incorrectly manufactured front wheel disc centre carriers may be subject to failure and may cause loss of control.
richiami.rimedio: Do not ride the vehicle. Vehicles must be collected by a dealer and replacement front brake discs fitted.
richiami.titolo: Incorrectly manufactured front wheel disc centre carriers may be subject to failure and may cause loss of control.

richiami.difetto: A bracket fitted under a previous recall has been discovered not to provide sufficient support to prevent shearing of the two securing bolts.
richiami.rimedio: Install the stronger mounting bracket support plate and bolt kit.
richiami.titolo: A bracket fitted under a previous recall has been discovered not to provide sufficient support to prevent shearing of the two securing bolts

richiami.difetto: One of the locating bolts on the rear disc brake may not be sufficiently tight or include a locking compound.
richiami.rimedio: Remove inspect clean and apply locking compound to all rear disc mounting bolts.
richiami.titolo: One of the locating bolts on the rear disc brake may not be sufficiently tight or include a locking compound.

richiami.difetto: The rear brake and exhaust bracket may�come into contact with�the road when the rear brake is applied if the securing bolts are to come loose.
richiami.rimedio: To immediately stop riding and provide and fit a reinforced bracket with an extra securing point. Additionally provide a locking nut on the back of the securing bolt to help prevent the bolt coming loose.
richiami.titolo: EXHAUST MOUNTING BRACKET BOLTS MIGHT COME OUT

richiami.difetto: Possibility of a missing bush from the rear brake pedal pivot.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect and fit a new bush if required and repair any consequential damage to associated components.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF A MISSING BUSH FROM THE REAR BRAKE PEDAL PIVOT

richiami.difetto: Possible weak points in the frame that under certain conditions could fail.
richiami.titolo: FRAME BREAKAGE TOWARDS FRONT SECTION OF THE MOTORCYCLE

richiami.difetto: The rear brake pads have exceeded the disc and once they have worn to a certain level then the rear brake may become inoperable. The front brake will still work as they are independent.
richiami.rimedio: The dealers will be required to change the calliper mounting bracket and brake pads.
richiami.titolo: REAR BRAKE PADS HAVE EXCEEDED THE DISC

richiami.difetto: The Combined Braking valve has a rubber washer fitted to a threaded fitment. The rubber washer isn�t suitable for the purpose and has shown signs of allowing hydraulic fluid to pass. If the seal was to completely fail it would result in a complete brake failure. The motorcycle would lose all braking ability which could result in a serious incident.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the 225 machines that are likely to be affected and replace the front caliper two way valve brake hose and associated components.
